files.title: File:Commercial Bank and Trust Company Building, Main Street, Bowling Green, OH - 52393004087.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1924-1926, this Classical Revival-style bank building was designed by Leo Herman to house the Commercial Bank and Trust Company of Bowling Green.  The building later received a modern addition sometime in the mid-20th Century that is recessed from the original building and features a relatively blank facade and two concrete canopies in the front.  The original bank building features a stone-clad facade with a large front pediment roof with dentils and decorative acroterions atop the pea
